common_window.basis: MEASURED intersection of required six symbols' bar ranges within target window

frozen_gate_rule.text: T12_MATERIALITY_V1 (frozen before any V8 scoring): a REQUIRED symbol fails the T12 gate iff, within the MEASURED common window, any of: (a) zero 15m bars; (b) zero funding settlements; (c) total unexplained gap time > 24h AND > 0.5% of window duration; (d) duplicate bar timestamps present. Non-required warnings do not flip the gate. Endpoints are measured from data and are NOT trimmed to dodge gaps.

checks.detail: all audited symbols resolve to <SYM>-PERP.BINANCE USD-M perpetual bar directories
ts_event = exchange CLOSE stamps, UTC ns; strict monotonic + 15m grid alignment checked per symbol
high>=low, high>=open/close, low<=open/close, volume>=0 per bar
every consecutive-pair breach enumerated and classified; default unexplained; no preregistered rule file supplied -> ALL gaps unexplained
audit reads raw bars only; no price/funding imputation performed anywhere
required symbols must have >0 settlements inside measured common window

bundle requested_start begins ~2024-08-23, after the measured common-window start (~41h head shortfall, <0.25% of window); recorded per symbol as head/tail_uncovered_hours; does not flip the frozen materiality rule (settlements>0 throughout)
presence via Catalog.instrument(); single-snapshot store -> effective-timestamp limitation recorded per symbol
21 source files hashed; normalized manifest sha256 recorded
BTCUSDT audited benchmark-context-only; excluded from universe ranks/weights/PnL statements
window overlaps prior S0 inspection activity; NOT untouched OOS
endpoints = max(first bars)/min(last bars) over required symbols; no gap-dodging shrink
